newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mazda 1996/97 European sales up 12.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mazda 1996/97 European sales up 12.7 pct.

text.p: Mazda Motor Corp said on Tuesday that its car sales in Europe in the year ended on March 31 rose 12.7 percent from the previous year to 196,144 units.
It was the first year-on-year rise in six years, Mazda said.

Of the total, sales of the Mazda 626, called the Crono in Japan, rose 9.6 percent from a year earlier to 44,222 units, and sales of the MX-5, called the Eunos Roadster in Japan, rose 23.2 percent to 9,939 units.
Sales in Spain rose 138.2 percent to 2,182 units and those in Portugal rose 87.1 percent to 2,082 units.

The formation of Mazda's Portuguese unit in February 1995 and the acquisition in February 1996 of a 32 percent stake in Tecnitrade Automocion SA, Mazda's importer and distributor in Spain, contributed to strong sales in those countries, it said.
